readme: README 5.3 (conditions A-D, IMP-01~04), 6.1 (metrics, paired bootstrap), 1.1 (RQ-04 rules, applied at the development stage), 5.2 (ROB-01~04); stage-4 design D6; written by scripts/eval_abcd.py

rules.benign_fpr_change: FPR difference on the benign variants of ROB-01 main, ROB-01 homoglyph, ROB-04 benign_security: CI upper < 0 fpr_decrease, CI lower > 0 fpr_increase, else no_change
rules.bootstrap: groups = group_id (a validation row is its own group), merged when texts share build_lists.nk, strata = original label (mixed if several), numpy default_rng(314159) restarted per comparison, 2000 resamples, the same indices for both conditions; per resample the metric per seed (recall, FPR: ratio of summed counts; F1: sum of 2TP over sum of 2TP + FP + FN), 3-seed mean, then b - a; numpy.percentile 2.5 / 97.5 (linear); null CI when any resample is undefined
rules.cases: status assigned with review decision keep or relabel (label = new_label); pending or unapplied exclude refused; predicted with eval_cases.predict_runs for the A and C checkpoints, B and D by re-thresholding the float32 scores
rules.comparisons: primary A->B, A->C, A->D; secondary B->D, C->D, B->C
rules.conditions: A = s2-roberta-A-s<seed> at 0.5; B = the same checkpoints at the B thresholds; C = s4-roberta-C-s<seed> at 0.5; D = the same C checkpoints at the D thresholds
rules.decision: float32(score) >= threshold (eval_lib.predictions on a float32 tensor) everywhere
rules.metrics: eval_lib.metrics; label all only with both labels, 1: recall, 0: FPR; N/A is null; ROC-AUC on the margin (the same for A and B, and for C and D)
rules.numbers: non-integers rounded to 6 decimals, except max_abs_margin_diff_9_digits, threshold
rules.pooled: ROB-01~03 main = main-group cases of ROB-01, ROB-02, ROB-03 (ROB-01 case, space, char; homoglyph is held out)
rules.records: equal in the A and C run of a seed: budget N, budget eval_steps, budget updates_run, budget epochs, budget update_size, budget micro_batch, budget grad_accum, config SHA-256, list files SHA-256, dataset revision, model record (weights, precision, tokenizer), determinism, environment (environment = the whole env record of run.json, no entry exempt); may differ between A and C, both values reported, one value per trained condition: lists_meta SHA-256, build_lists SHA-256, code files SHA-256; equal in the three C runs: lists_meta SHA-256, build_lists SHA-256, code files SHA-256, augmentation record, augmentation rows, train_clean rows; attempt = the attempt number of run.json
rules.rq04_development: (1) ROB-01~03 main variant attack recall difference >= 0.1 and CI lower > 0; (2) validation_clean FPR increase CI upper <= 0.02; (3) validation_clean F1 decrease CI upper <= 0.01; all: confirmed, (1) only: tradeoff, not (1): not_confirmed; an undefined CI satisfies nothing
rules.seeds: mean and sample std (n - 1) over the seeds; null when any seed is N/A
rules.source_runs: A pinned by results/s2 (eval_cases.load_stage2); C verified like summarize_s2 (completed, official lists, clean code state, budget, model pins, augmentation recorded, reload check, checkpoint size and SHA-256, selection rule, predictions reproducing metrics.json at every eval step, condition C, threshold 0.5)
rules.stage: development result: validation_clean and the development cases were used for the threshold selection and the augmentation design; the verdicts are not the final verdict
rules.thresholds: entries of thresholds.json = JSON objects with the keys threshold, logit, run_id; one per seed and condition B|D; a float32 value in (0, 1) equal to sigmoid(logit) within 1e-06, logit on the grid k/20 within -8..8; required: cap_met (boolean), chosen tp, fp, fn, tn (integers, equal to the validation_clean counts used here) and the SHA-256 of run.json and predictions_validation.csv of every source run (equal to the files used here); when present, seed, condition, selected_step, checkpoint_sha256 and the SHA-256 of other run files must agree with the runs used here
rules.tolerance: comparisons with 0 and with the limits allow 1e-9 for float rounding
rules.validation_clean: in_clean rows of predictions_validation.csv at the selected step, stored scores and margins
